title: A linear law is frozen everywhere or nowhere
claim: For a locally finite GF(2)-linear law: (1) a parity is changed by a finite change at one solution exactly when at every solution, exactly when some finitely supported homogeneous solution changes it, so nativity does not depend on the world and a linear law is frozen everywhere or has the same finite moves everywhere; (2) a finite set of at least three variables carries a K1-K3 knot exactly when it is a minimal support of a fixed parity, and the knot is native under the source-aware reading exactly when every variable lies in the support of a finite move, so a frozen law has knots but no native knot; (3) a shift-invariant law on Z^d with n variable types has finitely supported homogeneous solutions exactly when its polynomial matrix has rank below n, exactly when its solution space has positive topological entropy. On Z^2, Tseitin and the gauge law have native loops and native knots, while Ledrappier's law and the combined Tseitin-gauge law are frozen and have knots but no native knot.
failure_conditions: On a declared law the generic rank deficit disagrees with the existence of finite moves in a box.
A rank-deficient law shows no growing finite-move lower bound on box entropy, or a full-rank law shows a finite move or a non-decreasing upper bound per site.
knotlab rejects a minimal fixed support or accepts a non-minimal one, or native knots differ from the stated pattern (all for Tseitin and gauge, none for Ledrappier and the combined law).
A linear law's flippable window variables differ between two worlds.
A control (rank at a point where entries vanish, nativity from boundary-supported solutions, world-independence on a non-linear law) is accepted.
The GF(2^31) modulus fails the irreducibility test.
foundation_claim_scope: Which linear laws admit finite changes of their solutions, and how K1-K3 knots relate to them. No native recurrence, composed topology, path, metric, space or physical claim.

validation.status: checked: prose proof; check.py verifies the GF(2^31) modulus, computes generic ranks, finite moves in boxes of radius 3 and 4 and box-entropy bounds for eleven laws on Z^2, enumerates every parity of the 3x3 window for five laws with knotlab verdicts on minimal and non-minimal fixed supports and nativity, and solves world-independence at two worlds per law; three controls rejected; no human or external review
validation.level: V1 prose proof with executable checks; cites Schmidt (1995), Kitchens-Schmidt, Lind-Schmidt (1999), Lind-Schmidt-Ward (1990), Ledrappier (1978) and HOLES-AT-INFINITY-20261020-001C-P001; no trusted kernel.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta. Statements 1 and 3 are classical in substance (finitely supported homoclinic points, ranks over the Laurent ring, entropy of algebraic Z^d-actions) and 2 is the standard description of minimal dual codewords. The delta is the reading: under the source-aware reading linear laws split into those whose knots are native at every world and frozen laws whose knots never are, invisible to the source-blind reading; and two laws with native loops can combine into a frozen one.
validation.independence: Written by Claude in one session at the repository owner's request on 2026-10-20.
